Drag a waveform to move its selected region. Drag the white handle, or use its slider, to change the audible master-volume envelope. Apply uses these timings and envelopes for this playlist pair at normal speed, even with Automix off. Shuffle and radio are excluded. Colored bands are audio frequencies, not separated vocals or instruments.

Local playlist audition: both tracks must be files on this phone (downloads work too). The bundled model reconstructs vocals and accompaniment on-device; some bleed is expected. This is not separate drums/bass. Separation modes are preview-only; Apply saves timing and master fades, not separated playback.
